# ASCII Fold

Vendored, unmodified ESM bundle from https://github.com/mitsenkov/ascii-fold.

- Version: 1.1.1
- Commit: cbe3efc1bcb708692a6f647afea72724b2b4f8cb
- Downloaded: 2026-11-10
- Code: MIT, copyright Maxim Tsenkov (see LICENSE).
- Bundled gifenc: MIT, copyright Matt DesLauriers (see gifenc.LICENSE.md).
- Bundled structure: KRAS G12D, PDB 6GJ8 chain A, PDB data under CC0.

The homepage uses the bundled structure; it does not request AlphaFold models
or load additional fonts. Site integration lives in /protein.js and /protein.css.
To update, replace ascii-fold.js with the upstream dist/ascii-fold.js bundle,
retain both license files, update this revision, and verify the homepage.
